name: TalkSport (DAB+ Malta)
description: TalkSport is broadcast in Malta on DAB+ (Labelled as 'Sports Channel' or 'Talk Sport'). It provides live English Premier League (EPL) commentary, which is highly relevant for Kalshi market bettors.
notes: Matches typically run on Saturday (Oct 17) and Sunday (Oct 18).
